scope_rule: This matrix makes current targets explicit. It does not waive an inherited mandatory requirement; reconcile any wider claim before publication.

reference_runner.label: ubuntu-24.04
reference_runner.hardware_evidence_scope: Values are recorded by the two successful native jobs in run 41937866009; foundation hardware was not recorded and cannot be inferred from another job.
reference_runner.hardware_rule: Capture actual CPU model, online/affinity counts, memory, kernel, disk, cgroup constraints and Docker version before execution. Missing historical hardware is unknown, not an inferred minimum.
reference_runner.isolation: One heavy qualification suite per runner. Separate CI jobs use separate runners. Required concurrency inside each workload remains unchanged.
reference_runner.drift_rule: Runner-image or hardware changes require a separately recorded baseline; do not silently combine measurements across environments.

local_runner.role: supported desktop host and separate diagnostic native reproduction environment
local_runner.storage: Dedicated durable Docker volume; native audit evidence cannot use tmpfs
local_runner.decision_rule: Retain local failures and investigate their causes. A hosted pass does not erase them; an arbitrary workstation performance result does not redefine the reference runner or waive a supported deployment failure.

unchanged_limits.rule: Existing per-cohort limits, sanitizer settings, sampling windows, concurrency, operation deadlines and audit retention remain authoritative. These are qualification budgets, not production sizing advice.

required_artifacts: versioned Python wheels and source distributions
offline_windows_bundle: No v1.2.1 bundle is currently delivered. Build and qualify a separately identified bundle if the final support claim includes one; do not relabel the historical v1.1 bundle.
external_requirements: independent implemented-system security reviewer and report
